_: Thu 29 Oct 2026, community slot, Halloween weekend. Sources READ 23 Oct 2026, each on a page showing the 2026 date: (1) Spooky Skelebration, Olde Town Conyers, Thu Oct 29, 5pm to 7pm family portion, 901 Railroad Street, Conyers: exploregeorgia.org listing provided by Olde Town Conyers (adult evening part after 7pm NOT used). (2) Trick or Treat on the McDonough Square, Fri Oct 30, 2pm to 5pm, 5 Griffin Street, McDonough: City of McDonough calendar (mcdonoughga.org/calendar); street address read through the fetch tool, confirm on the page. (3) Trunk or Treat, Rockdale County Sheriff's Office, Fri Oct 30, 6pm to 9:30pm, 911 Chambers Drive, Conyers: rockdalecountyga.gov events list. (4) 2026 Halloween Carnival, Morrow High School, 4930 Steele Road, Ellenwood, Sat Oct 31, 1pm to 4pm, Clayton County Parks and Recreation: claytoncountyga.gov news release of Oct 8, 2026 (no ZIP code used). Admission cost is not stated on the McDonough, Rockdale or Clayton pages, so no cost is claimed. The McDonough Square event also ran in the Oct 22 card; it is repeated because it is this week and Henry County has no other verified event.
